tools.description: Show full details about the Autonomiq agent — version, developer, repository, support, and usage guide.

tools.name: agent_info
tools.description: Return version, environment, and configuration info for the Autonomiq agent.

tools.name: check_status
tools.description: Check the status of the last test run for a Jira ticket. Returns pass/fail counts, duration, and timestamp from the most recent run.

ticketId.description: Jira ticket ID, e.g. JIRA-123. Omit to list all recent runs.

tools.name: generate_report
tools.description: Run tests for a Jira ticket and generate an HTML report. Returns the report file path and a pass/fail summary.

tools.name: run_api_tests
tools.description: Generate and run API tests from the Swagger / OpenAPI spec for a Jira ticket.

tools.name: run_tests
tools.description: Generate and run all tests (UI + API) for one or more Jira tickets. Returns a summary of generated scenarios and pass/fail results.

tools.name: run_ui_tests
tools.description: Generate and run Playwright UI (browser) tests for a Jira ticket.

instructions:
Autonomiq Test Agent v1.0.0
AI-powered QA agent — generates and runs Playwright UI + API tests from Jira tickets.

Developer   : Zulyar Kurban
Repository  : https://github.com/zulyarkurban/autonomiq-framework
Support     : support@mobileteknoloji.com
License     : MIT

HOW TO USE
Ask Copilot naturally — the agent picks up Jira ticket IDs and intent automatically:
  • "run tests for JIRA-123"
  • "UI tests only for JIRA-456"
  • "generate a report for JIRA-789"
  • "what is the status of JIRA-101"

TOOLS (7 loaded)
  about                Show full details about the Autonomiq agent — version, developer, repository, support, and usage guide
  agent_info           Return version, environment, and configuration info for the Autonomiq agent
  check_status         Check the status of the last test run for a Jira ticket
  generate_report      Run tests for a Jira ticket and generate an HTML report
  run_api_tests        Generate and run API tests from the Swagger / OpenAPI spec for a Jira ticket
  run_tests            Generate and run all tests (UI + API) for one or more Jira tickets
  run_ui_tests         Generate and run Playwright UI (browser) tests for a Jira ticket

REQUIRED SETUP (.env)
  JIRA_BASE_URL   https://your-instance.atlassian.net
  JIRA_USERNAME   your-email@example.com
  JIRA_API_TOKEN  your-jira-api-token

OPTIONAL
  SWAGGER_URL     https://api.example.com/swagger.json
  BROWSER         chromium | firefox | webkit  (default: chromium)
